answer: Tie standing to economic age, not one big bond. An identity gains weight only from a trail of real payments to many unrelated counterparties: each payment is a drop of umber, and the trail's pigment darkens only as months pass and counterparties diversify. A fresh identity starts near zero, since weight is capped by trail age and diversity. Running many identities means sustaining many months-long histories, while cluster checks merge identities sharing counterparties. The delta between honest and farmed histories widens with time, so farming stays slower and costlier than honest work.
